page_title: AUX 2-1 REI | Auxerre v Reims 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Florent Batta is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) receives a yellow card.
90+5' The referee has issued a yellow card to Clement Akpa (Auxerre).
90+5' 2 - 1 Keito Nakamura (Reims) heads the ball inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
85' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Rayan Raveloson (Auxerre), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
84' Gaetan Perrin will be replaced by Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre).
84' Luka Elsner prepares a substitution. Valentin Atangana Edoa is replaced by Amadou Kone (Reims).
81' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
77' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
76' Christophe Pelissier has decided to make a change. Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) replaces Florian Aye.
75' Christophe Pelissier is forced to make a change. Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Theo Bair.
74' A substitution has been made. Amine Salama is replaced by Niama Sissoko (Reims).
69' Gabriel Osho (Auxerre) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Clement Akpa.
67' Reims can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' The attendance is 17016.
63' None of the Reims players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
60' Substitution. Joseph Okumu (Reims) has come on for Cedric Kipre.
60' Here is a change. Buta is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Nhoa Sangui (Reims).
60' That's the end of the game for Teddy Teuma, who is replaced by Mamadou Diakhon (Reims).
59' Teddy Teuma (Reims) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
56' Buta (Reims) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florent Batta had an easy-decision to make.
52' 2 - 0 Gideon Mensah passes to Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Teddy Teuma (Reims) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
42' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
39' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Buta (Reims) heads on.
36' Penalty saved! Jubal (Auxerre) sends the penalty towards the right hand side of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
36' Jubal (Auxerre) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

34' Buta (Reims) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. It's a penalty! Auxerre have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
27' Reims are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
23' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) has tested the patience of referee Florent Batta and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Reims.
23' Referee Florent Batta signals NO PENALTY for Reims after a VAR review!
22' Referee Florent Batta makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Reims. Let’s see what happens!
22' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
20' Reims failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
19' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Reims comes to nothing.
18' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Auxerre players have a reason to celebrate!
18' Wait! Referee Florent Batta has indicated he is going to review the Auxerre goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
16' 1 - 0 Goal! The ball from the resulting free kick arrives at the feet of Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) inside the box, and he fires a lovely shot into the bottom left corner.
15' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
14' The resulting set piece from Auxerre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
12' Buta (Reims) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Florent Batta with no other option than to blow for a foul.
9' The Reims players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Reims have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
4' Amine Salama (Reims) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Reims can continue in their attacking effort.
1' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
